# Western Timber Frame

> > Manufacturer of premium timber frame pergolas, pavilions, and arbors featuring The Dovetail Difference joinery system and ShadeScape DIY kits in Douglas Fir.

Western Timber Frame specializes in outdoor shade structures with proprietary dovetail joinery that requires no nails, glue, or exposed hardware. Their ShadeScape product line offers DIY-friendly kits with various beam profiles (Champion, Classic, Roosevelt Step, Tear Drop) and finishes like Rich Cordoba stain, available through retailers including Costco.

## Key Topics

- The Dovetail Difference joinery system
- ShadeScape DIY kits
- Douglas Fir timber construction
- Timber frame pergolas and pavilions
- DIY installation methods
- Structural engineering for outdoor living
- Attached vs freestanding structures
- Champion and Classic beam profiles
- Rich Cordoba stain finish
- EarthAnchor foundation system
- Commercial shade structures
- Louvered roof designs
- Dovetail joints without hardware
- Roosevelt Step and Tear Drop profiles

## Core Products & Technology

- [Roughed From Nature Without Nails, Glue or Exposed Hardware](https://www.westerntimberframe.com/rough-dovetail-joint-system-without-nails-or-glue-or-exposed-hardware): Dovetail Difference joinery system with hidden fasteners and EarthAnchor
- [Intelligent Design, Recreational & Commercial Shade Structures](https://www.westerntimberframe.com/intelligent-design-solar-recreational-commercial-shade-structures): Commercial timber frame shade solutions with Dovetail Difference joinery
